_comment_1: Trust policy for the IAM role that .github/workflows/deploy.yml assumes.
_comment_2: Replace <ACCOUNT_ID>. Everything else is already correct for this repository.
_comment_3: The sub claim is minted by GitHub, not by the workflow file, and it ALWAYS begins with repo:<owner>/<name>. That prefix is what locks the role to this repository and nothing in a workflow can forge it. What varies is the rest of the claim, and getting that part wrong is the whole difficulty:
_comment_4: push / workflow_dispatch on a branch -> repo:owner/name:ref:refs/heads/<branch>
_comment_7: The deploy job declares `environment: production`, so the environment form is the one that arrives. A policy pinned to the ref form cannot match it, and the failure reads 'Not authorized to perform sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity' with no hint as to which claim disagreed.
_comment_8: IMPORTANT: this pins the environment, not the branch. Any branch in this repository can declare `environment: production`. The branch restriction therefore lives in GitHub, where it is actually enforced: repo Settings -> Environments -> production -> Deployment branches and tags -> Selected branches -> claude/prep-test-platform-design-fpiuqn. Without that setting this role is assumable from any branch here.
_comment_9: BOTH forms are listed below, and an array in StringEquals is an OR. This is not belt-and-braces: GitHub turned immutable subject claims on for this repository some time between 2026-08-13 and 2026-08-21, and the sub changed from the first form to the second with nothing on either side having been edited. A policy pinned to one form alone breaks the day that setting is toggled, in either direction, and the failure reads 'Not authorized to perform sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity' with no hint that a claim format moved underneath it.
_comment_10: Neither value is a wildcard. Both name this repository exactly, so listing both widens nothing - there is no third repository that can mint either string. The numeric ids are stable: 177206603 is the owner, 1328757020 is the repository.
_comment_11: The workflow prints the real sub before it assumes (see .github/workflows/deploy.yml). If this ever fails again, read that line rather than guessing - it is why the values below are known rather than assumed.
